items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I used to have the hardest time getting Jeff to sing... I used to tell Jeff... I used to kid him about that. ... There was Hilton Jefferson, who had just joined the band... He joined the band a week before I did... So there was Hilton Jefferson, Walter Thomas, Andrew Brown...

ctx.x: This tempo, yeah. And "hi-de-hi-de..." I used to have the hardest time getting Jeff to sing. Because Jeff didn't like to sing. He didn't think he could carry a tune.
